name: No AI Slop
description: Removes 20+ patterns of AI slop from writing while preserving the author's voice
ai_instructions: Use No AI Slop whenever the user asks you to improve, tighten, de-slop, or review a piece of writing. The skill removes 20+ mechanical patterns (binary contrasts like "It's not X. It's Y.", throat-clearing openers, faux-insight setups, colon reveals, dramatic fragments, importance puffery, weasel attribution, synonym cycling) WITHOUT flattening the author's vocabulary, cadence, or humour. Modes: edit the draft and list what changed; detect only, quoting each pattern without judging authorship; or deliberately generate slop as satire when asked. Never rewrite a voice you were not asked to change.

claude_command.name: no-ai-slop
claude_command.content:
# /no-ai-slop [is this slop?] <writing>

Edit or audit a piece of writing for AI-slop patterns.

1. Read the supplied text.
2. If the user asked "is this slop?", quote every pattern found — do not claim the text was AI-written.
3. Otherwise rewrite it: remove the slop patterns, keep the author's vocabulary, cadence and humour intact, then list what you changed.
4. Never flatten the voice you were asked to preserve.
